trigger: Unrecorded order intent outcome or INTENT_TERMINAL_REASON_NOT_RECORDED in SafeBroker journal when submission fails
root_cause: SafeBroker._submit_order_unlocked logs order_submission_intent, but when the broker throws an exception or validation fails, it resets state and re-raises without recording a terminal event in its journal.
verified_remedy: Wrap SafeBroker with AuditSafeBroker integration hook: record order_submission_rejected for pre-send rejections, order_accepted_unpersisted for post-acceptance persistence errors, and order_submission_unknown for in-flight transport exceptions.
limitations: Transport exceptions default to unknown because venue may have executed order; requires reconciliation to prove terminal state.
